findings.title: N3-F-08 repaired: seedFixture now grants the persona Opportunity object CRUD through a test-scoped PermissionSet, matching the requester's decision
findings.detail: Root cause per MOCK-DEPLOY-M3.md run 4: every one of the six test methods threw System.QueryException: sObject type 'Opportunity' is not supported at OpportunityApprovalService.submitBatch line 79 because the persona held Enterprise_Sales_Record_Types (record types plus two field permissions, no object grant) and no other permission set in this build or in sfskills-dev supplies Opportunity object CRUD. Fix: inside the existing self-user System.runAs(new User(Id = UserInfo.getUserId())) fence in seedFixture, insert a PermissionSet named Test_Opportunity_Access (Label 'Test Opportunity Access'), then one ObjectPermissions row (SobjectType Opportunity, PermissionsRead/Create/Edit true, PermissionsViewAllRecords false), then extend the existing PermissionSetAssignment insert to assign it to both manager and rep alongside personaSet. PermissionSet and ObjectPermissions are both on the mixed-DML setup-object list (apex/mixed-dml-and-setup-objects), so both inserts had to stay inside that fence rather than the persona runAs blocks in the @IsTest methods — they already did, so no new fence was introduced.
